tiers.name: 100M Individual 64KB Files (.jpg/.json) + Per-Rank glob() on Lustre/BeeGFS
tiers.note: Every 64KB sample triggers 3 synchronous MDS RPCs (open/stat/close) -> saturates MDS at 120K IOPS while 200 GB/s OSTs sit 99.3% idle (1.4 GB/s)!

tiers.name: Monolithic LMDB / HDF5 With Random mmap() Page Reads Over Network PFS
tiers.note: Eliminates MDS file-open storm, but random 64KB mmap reads across a 6TB LMDB trigger Lustre LDLM extent lock thrashing and 1MB OST read-amplification!

tiers.name: WebDataset 512MB Contiguous .tar Shards (Sequential OST Streaming)
tiers.note: Packs 8,192 samples per 512MB shard (cutting MDS IOPS 8,000x to 15 IOPS) and streams sequentially at 148.0 GB/s, but lacks O(1) random mid-shard resume.

tiers.name: MosaicML MDS / Lance Indexed 512MB Shards + lfs setstripe -c 1 + Node NVMe Cache
tiers.note: 1-OST-per-shard striping (-c 1) + O(1) byte-offset index + node-deduplicated local NVMe ring cache -> 186.0 GB/s (132.9x faster) & 0.4% GPU stall!
